name: 이바
visual_review: 긴 금발과 차분한 자주색 눈·흰 의상 정체성을 유지했습니다. 손 모으기·무릎 굽힘·양팔 방출·채널링 반동·구체 회수 동작이 구분됩니다. 빔은 일부 셀 가장자리 가까이까지 그려져 미리보기 여백을 확보해야 합니다.
motion_summary: Eva pale blonde-pink long hair, white-black elegant experimental costume, purple floating VF orb from identity. Official R is a channelled directional psychic VF beam. Animate poised idle with orb near hand; eyes focus right; both hands draw violet light toward chest; knees bend; arms extend to right; narrow purple beam begins at palms; wide layered amethyst-white VF stream pulses to right; head/torso leans into channel; sharper last pulse; beam narrows and palms recoil; orbiting orb reforms; original idle. Beam must stop with substantial transparent margin, never crosses a cell. Keep face visible above beam, calm gentle eye shape rather than angry Nia face. Violet/lilac/white with few cyan highlights.
